digest.component_or_area: LLM provider configuration and model resolution
propositions: A bare gemini-* model id resolves through infer_provider to 'google_genai', a provider name not in _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or ProviderSession._builders, causing LLMConfigError at call time.

The model-class resolution path (model_classes._resolve_target) uses infer_provider's result verbatim and composes a qualified provider string that ProviderSession cannot construct, whereas the anthropic_model._pai_model path accidentally survives via a private _PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX translation table.
The defect breaks at CALL time, not config time, leaving an operator with a plausible config that fails only when a gate runs.

_PROVIDER_PREFIXES must map gemini to 'google', which is pydantic-ai's current canonical Gemini Developer API provider name and is already registered in both KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES and _pydantic_ai_known_providers().

All values in _PROVIDER_PREFIXES must map to provider names that are either in _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or in ProviderSession._builders to prevent future prefixes from reintroducing this class of defect.
